items.title: Pentagon Suspends CMMC Phase 2 as It Rethinks Contractor Cybersecurity Rules
items.description: A new CMMC review and reform task force will conduct a comprehensive review of the program. The post Pentagon Suspends CMMC Phase 2 as It Rethinks Contractor Cybersecurity Rules appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Microsoft Maps Year-Long ShinyHunters-Linked Salesforce Data Theft Across Three Paths
items.description: Attackers whose methods line up with the data-extortion group ShinyHunters have spent the past year walking into corporate Salesforce environments without exploiting a single flaw in the platform. items.title: Telegram’s t.me Domain Suspended, ServerHold Status Breaks Links Worldwide
items.description: Telegram’s core t[.]me domain has been placed on serverHold at the .me registry, a registry-level status that removes the domain from the global DNS and breaks every t[.]me short link worldwide. WHOIS records confirm the domain now carries eight status flags, including serverHold, clientDeleteProhibited, and serverDeleteProhibited, with an update timestamp of 2026-07-13T19:24:55Z.
